component.name: RPFM
component.summary: A modding tool for Total War games

description.p: RPFM (Rusted PackFile Manager) is a modding tool for Total War games. It allows you to open, edit and save Pack Files for every Total War since Empire: Total War, and ships integrated editors for DB tables, Loc files, scripts, animations, portrait settings, rigid models, videos and a long list of other formats.
